About Us

For over 35 years, Trattoria Nonno has been a gathering place for families, friends, and lovers of authentic Italian cuisine. What began as Nonno Giuseppe's dream in 1987 has grown into a beloved Florence institution, where every meal is prepared with the same love and care he brought to his kitchen.

Our Story

Nonno Giuseppe emigrated from Naples in 1985 with his wife, Nonna Maria, bringing with them recipes passed down through four generations and an unwavering belief that food connects us all. They opened our doors in a small corner of Florence with just eight tables and a wood-fired oven that still sits in our kitchen today.

Their children grew up running between tables, learning to cook from their parents and grandparents. Today, Chef Marco (Nonno's grandson) leads our kitchen, while his sister Elena manages our dining room with the same warmth their great-grandparents showed to every guest.

We remain family-owned and operated because, for us, this isn't just a restaurant—it's a home where we welcome you to our table.

Our Philosophy

Authenticity

Every dish follows recipes developed over decades in Italian kitchens. We use traditional techniques and source authentic ingredients from trusted suppliers, many with roots in Italy. We never compromise on what's real.

Quality Ingredients

We believe the best cooking starts with the best ingredients. Our pasta is made fresh daily. Our produce arrives from local farmers who share our standards. Our olive oil comes from a family grove in Tuscany, just as it has for 30 years.

Community

Italian food is meant to be shared. Trattoria Nonno is where families celebrate, friends reconnect, and strangers become part of our extended family. Every guest leaves as part of our story.

Come Dine With Us

When you sit at a table in Trattoria Nonno, you're not just a customer—you're a guest in our home. You'll experience the warmth of Italian hospitality, the flavors of our heritage, and the joy of food made with passion. Whether you're celebrating a milestone, enjoying a quiet evening, or bringing your family together, we're honored to be part of your moment.

Visit us soon. Nonno's table is set, and there's always room for one more.
